description: This file contains the implementation of the IpcClientControllerImpl class and related factory functions within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It manages RPC controller state, including resetting, failure status, error messages, and handling method call failures. It also includes factory creation functions for IPC controllers.

classes.name: IControllerFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating IPC controller factories.

classes.name: ControllerFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IControllerFactory that creates ClientControllerImpl instances.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an IPC client controller managing RPC call states and failures.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ClientControllerImpl instance.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the controller's failure state and reason, preparing it for a new RPC call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Returns whether the last RPC call failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error message if the last call failed.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Logs a warning that canceling is not implemented.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state and reason for a method call failure, with a string reason.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state and reason for a method call failure, with a formatted message.
